# About This Sample {.unnumbered}

This short book is sample content shipped with the Colophon toolkit
— not a real business case study. Every chapter, table, figure, and
citation mechanism it demonstrates is documented in full in the main
toolkit's README and `docs/BOOK-CREATION-GUIDE.md`.

![The Colophon toolkit's placeholder logo — swap this file for a real one when building your own book.](logo-placeholder.png){width=192px fig-align=center fig-alt="A placeholder logo box."}

\vspace{12pt}

To use this sample as a starting point for your own book: copy this
`sample/` folder out on its own, replace the fictional content in
each chapter with your own, and update `brand.tex` and
`title-page-content.tex` with your real title, colors, and fonts.

{{< pagebreak >}}

# Thank You {.unnumbered}

Thanks for trying Colophon. If something in this sample didn't
render the way this page describes, that's a real bug worth
reporting — see `CONTRIBUTING.md` in the main toolkit.
